metadata.case_name: LEE CHUI YING AND ANOTHER v. CHAN YEE LING ELAINE

plaintiff.occupation_before: the principal partner of the Firm (Messrs. Christine M. Koo & Yip)

injuries.description: ulcer over the right side of the upper lip
injuries.body_part: right side of the upper lip
source: Examination showed an ulcer over the right side of the upper lip and a 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose.
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of lip or oral cavity

injuries.description: 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose
source: Examination showed an ulcer over the right side of the upper lip and a 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose.
The Defendant was diagnosed of post-traumatic stress disorder and prescribed a course of anti-depressant in late October 2011.
Subsequently, she was found to have mild to moderate depressive disorder.

manifestations.description: ulcer over the right side of the upper lip
1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose
pain in the neck and shoulder
symptoms of mild to moderate depressive disorder

treatments_received.treatment: Attendance at Canossa Hospital and course of antibiotics
source: After the incident, she attended Canossa Hospital for treatment. Examination showed an ulcer over the right side of the upper lip and a 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose. She was given a course of antibiotics and discharged.

treatments_received.treatment: Medical assessment at Tang Shiu Kin Hospital (no physical or neurological deficit identified)
source: According to the medical report of Dr. Yio of Tang Shiu Kin Hospital dated 7th December 2011, no physical or neurological deficit was identified when she attended Tang Shiu Kin Hospital on 1st August 2001.
The Defendant was diagnosed of post-traumatic stress disorder and prescribed a course of anti-depressant in late October 2011.

treatments_received.treatment: Psychiatric treatments and counselling services from psychiatrist and psychologist in the private sector
source: She then received psychiatric treatments and counselling services from psychiatrist and psychologist in the private sector.

treatments_received.treatment: Dental treatment for a fractured tooth
source: The Defendant received dental treatment for a fractured tooth some two months after the incident.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities suffered by the 2nd Plaintiff
Pain, suffering and loss of amenities due to post-traumatic stress disorder and mild to moderate depressive disorder
